notes.title: 1.4.6 Patch Notes - "Better Together"
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello Wizarding Folk![/h1][/b]
We're releasing this patch to cover a few content bugs released with the "Better Together" update. 
If you've had trouble getting an achievement, or completing your library -- read on! 

[b]Spoiler Warning: Endgame Content![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[b][h2]"Better Together" - 1.4.6 Patch Notes[/h2][/b]



[b]General Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Boomerang powder should now be accessible in the physics station in older saves
[*] Lover's Quarrel, Vulf Sniper, and other bounty guns have been adjusted to appear in the correct bounty loot tables (time to complete your collections)! 
[*] "Shattered Soul" should now have the correct description
[*] “0/1 gears collected” has been fixed to read "0/0 gears collected" if you have unlocked the entire Shatter
[*] The Achievement "Chaos Reined" will be unlocked regardless of which ending you get (you will have to re-defeat the last boss to get this achievement)
[*] Hilda's wanted poster will now spawn next to the Oculus in late game saves! 
[*] The bookcases in the Mechantress tower will no longer be scannable!
[/list]


[b]Known Issues![/b]
[list]
[*] The Huntress might incorrectly loop an idle animation. 
[*] Charmed entities that have been revived might incorrectly display on the map (your zombie children are not real!)
[*] Swapping items into processing stations might no longer remember their origin (it was in your backpack, but now it’s in the chest)
[*] The “burning” VFX might obscure some smaller enemies 
[*] Odden’s Middle Finger might not display correctly on the gun mount building 
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
You can keep up to date by following our [url=https://twitter.com/galvanicgames]twitter[/url] or joining our [url=https://t.co/s2afqOPxl4]discord[/url] (and sometimes chat directly with us!). 

See you wandpokes next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f6b86c9541219757ad66c65785725de005f15255.gif[/img]

notes.title: "Better Together" Free Content Update - LIVE NOW
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Howdy there Wizards,  [/h1][/b]
[h3]We're happy to announce that we've gone and done it:

[b]4-player co-op is here! [/b][/h3]

[h2]The "Better Together" update is live right now! [/h2]

This is a free update that increases multiplayer to up to four wizards. It also includes a large number of content changes that we’re excited to share. If you’re curious about everything we’ve been working on, read below.

If you're one of those wise-wizards who likes to get down to brass bullets, you can check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150530/view/4169846932066074139]our bulleted patch notes[/url] for this update! 

[previewyoutube=ZTV0rPQ0_ik;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[h2]4 Players can now explore the Shatter Together[/h2]

[b]Finally. [/b]

Gather three wizard friends and log on! The shatter is open for you to explore. Be careful, with increased wandpower comes increased challenges! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/4e66a3675fd72f448d30087ece159450aed26cb5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2]Over Easy or Hard Boiled[/h2]

[h3]New Difficulty Levels[/h3]
Customize your experience to your preferred skill and challenge level with four unique difficulty levels.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/aafabbc45eb6cb9ed4bf2c68242616e03fc0fcde.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Ranger [/b] - a less challenging experience with lower penalties for failure.
[*] [b]Gunslinger  [/b] - the default difficulty setting.
[*] [b]Sheriff  [/b] - a more challenging experience than default.
[*] [b]Outlaw [/b] - a brutal and demanding experience, not for the faint of wand!
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/3c45575b3306a7edafbee010419b23e0562c1ecd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/4d3fdd04fd60b7b20216167c05c14eb503038c29.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Custom Difficulty[/h3]
If you’re not sure what mode to choose, don’t worry, we’ve introduced a several sliders for you to customize your difficulty in whatever way you wish. Adjust the game to suit your desires, including: 
[list]
[*]Damage Received 
[*]Enemy Health
[*]Enemy Speed
[*]Apocalypse Rate
[*]If items are lost in death [Toggle]
[*]If Arcana is lost in death [Toggle]
[*]Difficulty scales per player [Toggle] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2]Lore Galore[/h2]

[h3]Libraries[/h3]
Available to all wizards by default, the recipe for the [b]general library[/b] can be found in the worldbuilder!

“But, Galvanic,” we hear you say “we already have bookshelves!” 

Not like this one, you don’t! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/27898c50d02c8cc9a2a20ecbdccc82b2403015d5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/b05c87a42b01402ed16bb67ec88f45088067aea7.png[/img][/url]

These sturdy shelves hold all the secrets you’ve collected in your journey, and allow you to easily access your favorite pieces of lore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f0617bebef66f5c5b04ad7f8508417775bc703ab.gif[/img]

Each shelf in this library reflects a specific archetype of magic. We’ve added bookshelf variant recipes that reflect that archetype's style, too – but they’re only available to the wizards that persevere. Collecting enough literature to fill a shelf will reward you with its associated bookshelf recipe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/3f0a4d3c643bab6643d3954753e6013d94b05c4a.gif[/img]

[h3] New Lore [/h3]
New reading materials can also be found in areas around the shatter and in boss arenas. Discover the secrets of the gods and the Imperium's final days. Find out why Hilda's riders have a bounty on them. Read some poetry. Super-sorcerer-slueths will have plenty to uncover in this update.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/73689e11224933e182e2a8044fb234bdd81b3cfc.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2]A Secret beyond the Oculus[/h2]

[b]Do you dare explore what waits for you?[/b]
There is something lurking in the depths of the void, beyond the gate of the Oculus. Gather your friends and find out what waits for you  – if you dare! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f0d20cff18aef57109456ba6f417f25f86307b98.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[h2]Thank you, Wizards![/h2]

We're always so grateful for y'all taking the time to play our game. We have been so incredibly lucky to make this for you and we appreciate everyone who has given us feedback, participated in community discussions, chatted in our discord, and liked our social media content. Your continued support and participation is what is keeping this game alive!

Please continue to use the in-game user report button (found in any menu) to report issues or give us additional feedback. You can also keep up to date by following our [url=https://twitter.com/galvanicgames]twitter[/url] or joining our [url=https://t.co/s2afqOPxl4]discord[/url] (and sometimes chat directly with us!). Please continue to let us know what you think about the game, and what can make it better in the future!

See you wandpokes next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f6b86c9541219757ad66c65785725de005f15255.gif[/img]

notes.title: "Better Together" 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello Wizarding Folk![/h1][/b]

Warning, the following patch notes include some minor spoilers for the “Better Together” update, if you’d like to stay spoiler-free, please click away!

If you’d like to read up on what’s included in this update with pictures, please reach the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150530/view/4169846932066068435]main announcement post.[/url]

For the data-driven magi who are fine with the juicy details, you can find all the particulars listed below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[b][h2]"Better Together" - 1.4 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Content[/h3][/b]
[list][*] Multiplayer supports up to 4 players per game session
[*] 4 preset difficulty modes and custom difficulty options
[*] Additional lore and books throughout the game
[*] New Library UI (for the lore!)
[*] 5 new bookshelf variants 
[*] Added “activated” version of the Oculus
[*] Voidskimmer can now be interacted with in the Tower
[*] Updated endgame content and secret ending 👀 
[*] 5 new achievements to unlock
[*] New music featuring the bard! 
[/list]

[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated VFX & animations for entities
[*] Updated VFX & animations for some buildings in game
[*] Updated SFX for new content and some Bounty of Guns weapons
[*] Map Altar Activation VFX updated
[*] Difficulty scaling will be notified to players at the start of the expedition
[*] Updated credits to include: Michael Garrett Steele (voice of the bard)!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]

[b] Resources, Recipes, Crafting and Building[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing thumbnails and incorrect thumbnails in the First Edition
[*] Spawned items and resources should now decay properly 
[*] Bounty rewards should fall into the void less frequently
[*] Rotated stone chests should now always close if they contain items
[/list]

[b]Spells and Powders[/b]
[list]
[*] “On Fire” scale should be a little less egregious on large enemies 
[*] Fixed fire flickering on entities that teleport 
[*] Fixed mortar impacts being immortal in the tower (dripping oil will no longer haunt you forever)
[*] Order spells should now consistently repair buildings in the tower
[*] Fixed performance when shooting poison into water
[*] Introduced Boomerang powder in the physics research station
[/list]

[b]Enemies, NPCs and Combat[/b]
[list]
[*] Pet & Charmed interactions have received some polish 
[*] Hilda animations have been updated 
[*] All applicable entities should now be able to be scanned with the First Edition
[*] Fixed “assist when knocked” issues in multiplayer games
[*] Harbinger will now always spawn from a rift (the Oculus holds deeper secrets now)
[*] Updates to Golden Bounty rewards (New stuff? New stuff!)
[*] Fixed interaction with bounty mechana in boss arenas
[*] Sniper Cultists now have double health (they were too easy!)
[/list]

[b]Other / Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed audio balance for the Harbinger of Chaos fight
[*] Updated and fixed several boss biome books (if you’re missing a book, I would start at Orion’s tower 👀)
[*] Moved credits and endgame slideshow to end of new content
[*] Fixed UI for minimized task list (it should no longer cut off for some users)
[*] Extended connection timeout to allow for slower connections
[*] Adjusted Hermit Crab ambush to be more performant
[*] Fixed arrows in loading bench tutorial
[*] Fixed crashes on client after being kicked from a multiplayer game
[/list]

[b]Known Issues + Things we’re working on![/b]
[list]
[*] Boomerang powder might not unlock if you've already completed some physics research (we're patching this in the next update!)
[*] The Huntress might incorrectly loop an idle animation. 
[*] An endgame quest might appear incomplete in multiplayer (the game will still progress, you'll just have the quest marker active)
[*] Some bounty guns will not be available (these are being patched back in soon!) 
[*] "Shattered Soul" has an incorrect description (woopsie!)
[*] Charmed entities that have been revived might incorrectly display on the map (your zombie children are not real!)
[*] Swapping items into processing stations might no longer remember their origin (it was in your backpack, but now it’s in the chest)
[*] The “burning” VFX might obscure some smaller enemies 
[*] Odden’s Middle Finger might not display correctly on the gun mount building 
[*] “0/1 gears collected” might display after collecting all gears (there is not a secret hidden gear, I promise) 
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch - 1.3.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Wizarding Folk! 
While we’re hard at work on our next big update “Better Together” we cleaned up a few bugs that were hanging around in the shatter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]

[h1]  1.3.7 Patch Notes [/h1]
[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a couple of performance related crashes when several enemies spawn at once. 
[*] Fixed a couple of multiplayer related crashes due to incompatible save files. 
[*] Updated some map icons! They should be clearer to read now! 
[*] Updated bounty board images, and some first edition images too! 
[*] Several performance fixes have been added to help in later game areas. 
[/list]

[b]Resources, Recipes, Crafting and Building[/b]
[list]
[*] Plague doctor mask, jester hat,  and a couple of other costumes have had typos fixed. 
[*] Fixed some entities not unlocking in the First Edition, some spelling errors, and missing entries! Let’s get learning! 
[*] The Hidden Bush collection Splash image should now show all items unlocked. 
[*] Some building variant names were fixed for typos! 
[/list]

[b]Spells and Powders[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few edge cases with charm spells and charmed entities not behaving as expected.
[*] Replaced missing SFX for some guns and spells
[/list]

[b]Enemies, NPCs and Combat[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some gear icons not appearing above the heads of enemies that drop them.
[*] Fixed the chance for some chaos rifts to spawn invisible (they should be easier to track down now). 
[*] Made some minor adjustments to “Jeremy Edwards” combat 
[*] See if you can find the new exploding puff ball changes  in the Fell! 
[/list]



[b]Known Issues + Things we’re still working on! [/b]
[list]
[*] Kingpin will be missing an icon! where did they go???
[*] There are some goofy animations and missing sounds for some late-game enemies.
[*] Some users might experience additional performance issues in the Barren Sea 
[*] If you’d like to report poor performance: please use the “User Report” button on your esc menu 
[*] Some users might dislike the game! (We’re sorry! We’re trying really hard!)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]

[b]Thank you, Wizards![/b]
Our players are the whole shatter to us. Thank you for enjoying the thing we lovingly create, and thank you for continuing to give us feedback, chatting on our discord, or liking our social media posts. We’re really looking forward to releasing “Better Together” and everything that the team has been working on!

Please continue to use the in-game user report button (found in any menu) to report issues or give us additional feedback. You can also keep up to date by following our twitter or joining our discord (and sometimes chat directly with us!). 

See you cowpokes next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/f6b86c9541219757ad66c65785725de005f15255.gif[/img]

notes.title: Quick Patch! "Bounty of Guns" 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Wizarding Folk! 

We had a couple of bugs we wanted to fix for y'all that deserved it's own patch.  If you would like to read up on all the dastardly details of our most recent update [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150530/view/4133813065561912050]please follow up on our main announcement post. [/url]


[h1]  1.3.5 Patch Notes [/h1]
[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Guns should no longer vanish from their mounts! (although we're looking into harnessing the invisibility powers we discovered into something cool)
[*] Fixed an issue where deconstructed/destroyed chests would remain until a refresh! (phantom chests be gone!)
[*] Some Buildings should no longer look [i]squished[/i] (they got a confidence boost!)
[*] Mortars should now be unlocked at Young Joshua if you've unlocked the equivalent blueprint level!
[*] Some text should be fixed for Wonk's guns!
[*] We've made sure that First Edition entries are unlockable! (scan away!)
[*] Fixed one minor gear in the Frozen Wastes (it should now appear on the map!)
[/list]




[b]Known Issues + Things we’re still working on! [/b]
[list]
[*] Some bounties might be missing their images on the bounty board (how mysterious!) 
[*] Gun mounts are sometimes called “Small Chest” (technically true!)
[*] You cannot destroy Bounty Rewards (chests) in the “Arcane Annihilator” (You thought you were slick, huh?)
[*] Some users might dislike the game! (We’re sorry! We’re trying really hard!)
[/list]

notes.title: "Bounty of Guns" 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Wizarding Folk! 

We’re proud to announce our biggest update to date: “Bounty of Guns!” This update has over 50 guns, new enemies, new events and plenty to discover. If you would like to read up on all the dastardly details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150530/view/4133813065561912050]please follow up on our main announcement post. [/url]

For the data-driven mages, you can find all the particulars listed in below. 
[h1] "Bounty of Guns" - 1.3 Patch Notes [/h1]

[h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3]
[b]Costume Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Bounty Hunter DLC costumes 
[*] Hidden Bush Twitch Drop DLC 
[b][*] Shadow Money DLC available to ALL PLAYERS
[/b][/list]

[b] Bounty of Guns [/b]
[list]
[*] Bounty Entities 
[*] Bounty Rewards and Quests
[*] Bounty Board and Hunting
[*] Bounty Mechana and Reward system
[*] Gun type: Mortar 
[*] Gun type: Minigun

[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated VFX for several buildings in the game
[*] Updated SFX for several areas of the game
[*] Map Altar Activation VFX updated
[*] Swapping bullet slots added in the loading bench
[*] Strum timing on the main menu has been “nudged” (This was important to Ryan)

[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Twitch Chat can now name bounty entities!|

[*][i] Have Fun![/i]

[b]Resources, Recipes, Crafting and Building[/b]
[list]
[*] Wood walls should always give the correct amount of resources ( 👀 we see you trying to game the wood economy!)

[*] Fixed SFX for First Edition pick up in tutorial
[*] Increased range on the chest sharing (a few more tiles for you!)
[/list]

[b]Spells and Powders[/b]
[list]
[*] Faster bullet powder should no longer be unlocked by default

[/list]

[b]Known Issues + Things we’re working on! [/b]
[list]
[*] Some bounties might be missing their images on the bounty board (how mysterious!) 
[*] Gun mounts are sometimes called “Small Chest” (technically true!)
[*] Guns might vanish from their mounts! They're still there, just invisible! (opening the mount and resetting the gun will fix this)
[*] Occasionally a chest will remain in the world but lose collision (it's a phantom chest!)
[*] Sometimes buildings might look [i]squished[/i] (they're shy)
[*] You cannot destroy Bounty Rewards in the “Arcane Annihilator” (You thought you were slick, huh?)
[*] Some users might dislike the game! (We’re sorry! We’re trying really hard!)
[/list]

notes.title: Bounty Of Guns: Free Content Update - LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]


[h1][b]Hello again gunslingers! 
[/b][/h1]

[h3]We're happy to announce that we finally did it:

[b]We added more guns! [/b][/h3]



The "Bounty of Guns" update is live! This is a free update to all players and will automatically be downloaded the next time you play. 
This update includes new weapons, enemies, quests and more. There is even a few new costumes you can buy to support us making this game. Overall, this our biggest update to date, and there is so much to talk about -- so please keep your wands and arms inside the vehicle as we breakdown what's inside. 

If you're one of those wise-wizards who likes to get down to brass bullets, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1150530/view/4133813065561923525][b]check out our bulleted patch notes for this update![/b][/url]



[previewyoutube=-jkxOq-vyu4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[h2]Bounty Hunting[/h2]

[b]Bounty of Enemies[/b]
The shatter has gotten more dangerous, and a little more crowded. If you track down a bounty you might be surprised at the difficulty of the encounter. Fret not! If you return the proof of bounty to a Bounty Mechana you’ll be rewarded with a treasure any gunsmith would be jealous of. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/5a87897d8c5fa2c53c236cedcecfa8ed8dc8a445.gif[/img]

[b]Bounty of Board[/b]
These nasty new inhabitants might be causing a ruckus but there are those looking to clean it up. If you spot a board in your travels, take a peek. You might see a few marks posted for reward! Spending a little arcana will give you the right heading, and you just have to track them down and defeat them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/0854bbefdf0b9c06fa14ad4e374cf0c867d5a472.png[/img]

[b]Bounty Mechana[/b]
Now that you have defeated a bounty mark, how do you collect? The Bounty Mechana is your ticket to a pretty new piece of kit! Simply return the proof of the dangerous criminal you have slain ([i]or defeated by other means[/i]) and out pops a brand new gunwand! [i] Disclaimer: Bounty rewards vary in quality and type --  so keep collecting to increase your chances of new magic-sticks![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/54592050c45fdc97ec0e06f91cf17b6a5ebcfa4e.png[/img]

[b]Mysterious Minibosses[/b]
Are you an expert arcane alchemist looking for more of a challenge? Do you wander the shatter looking for the next big mark? For the wizards who have completed the game and are looking for an extra challenge, four unique additional bosses await your encounter. Find them hiding away in each biome, and collect their bounty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/45162e56c6c86e1c891846032f14826f05655f1e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/dbcb6e3dee70ee48be0a155e433f5e5fb885effd.png[/img]
[h2] Bounty Rewards[/h2]

[b]Bounty of Guns[/b]
The titular star of the show: GUNS! If you thought that bounties would return just any [i]Joshua[/i] number, you’re far off the mark. That’s right: over 50 new guns to gather and gawk at –  Some are a bit rarer than others. Turn in your precious bounty rewards for a chance to gain any of the following beauties ([i]and more[/i])! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/8ec0a0ffa61d756de90040973d85716868c53cc2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/a9e1c87ef7aeada9fb91a9e83a471c1852ac3735.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/6d1c61ee917d2940bcca10213bd8b6f754b68d90.png[/img]


[b] New Gun Types [/b]
The keen eyed gunslingers in the crowd may have noticed our new guns contain a few surprises. There are several new firing styles included in the “Bounty of Guns” update. From mortar shots that fly in beautiful arc, to charged shots that deal a large blow of damage there is something for any type of wizard. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/b86d5cf45b6bd4506bd36013b17148d04eb4cc23.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/6ec8767003ee5a22dfae8b1e44c4de89eee64023.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/418c4f049c14f0f42211697173b1704eb8b626af.gif[/img]

[b]Gun Mount[/b]
If you are precious about your collection, feel free to show it off in your tower with a sturdy mount. You can even feature classic guns on one of these beauties. Start an entire library dedicated to your collection if you’re brave enough. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/4a4f9737830995fd87c5a0c9d95e0fd9792551f0.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46ef832dc605c5497bd5437b62d128bbc74b9232.png[/img]
[h2] Events Galore! [/h2]

[b]Surprise Events[/b]
The word has spread of your bounty hunting and several inhabitants of the shatter are also after you. Keep an eye out for airships full of arcana hungry cultists, buried Mechlander hoards, hidden Vulf packs, sunken Phibb herds, or camouflaged crab flocks.

notes.title: Improved Wizarding I Update 1.2 is Live Now
notes.notes:
Hello Wizarding Folk! 

We hope you all enjoyed your first month on the Shatter. We've been hard at work improving the game, and we’d like to share some of those improvements with you today!

Buckle in because there are three main parts to this update: Festive glamours for your clothing, new communication tools for multiplayer, and significant improvements to item management and chests.  At the bottom of this post you’ll find our usual list of patch items, but we’ll highlight the exciting bits first.

[h3]Feature 1 | Festive Clothes for All Sorts[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/a3f2ef9a67dacae35ba30fc5e10363c4e0524070.png[/img]
Start your magical winter off right with several new costume glamours! Bring out your inner forest-dwelling Magus with a fresh set of robes, gloves, boots, and wooden mask or enjoy a good night's sleep with the new bedtime wizard hat. Also included in this update: a dainty silver lace mask and a flowery poinsettia hat.

[h3]Feature 2 | New Communication Tools[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/46a900b56daa06066200531b98ea6b764c0b5cc4.png[/img]
Wondering what your friend is up to? This patch includes several key updates to messaging and communication. Keep your eye out for on-screen notification in multiplayer games letting you know when your ally enters the tower, starts an expedition, or fails you and dies. Off-screen indicators will be shown for other players and charmed allies – making it easier to track them down in sticky situations.

However, the biggest addition to this patch is a wheel-of-magical-communication! 

If you wish to communicate with your fellow wizards hold the comms wheel key (default G on keyboard) to select your chosen message. This unique expression will appear above your hat as well as on the world map. This mechanic can be used in any situation while exploring the shatter, including:

Telling your buddy they’re doing a great job
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/d607ba0d44b208d0a745b9b6ca69d7e70ae53c55.gif[/img]

Expressing your sadness at the passing of a beloved pet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/cc6c6439d5e26370725db34227fee076e00d7339.gif[/img]

Letting a teammate know the location of resources, or other goodies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/38d9ee2b05455c43cf14101724bad8831f520032.gif[/img]

[h3]Feature 3 |  Resource UI Improvements[/h3]
Finally, to make your crafting, collecting and cataloging of resources easier, we’ve introduced a small number of UI improvements. 

All wizards will be able to access chests, crafting stations and most other buildings simultaneously. No more bumping into your buddy when you’re attempting to reload your wand. 

Use the “Store All” button on any chest to immediately move the entire contents of your backpack into safety. In addition, use the “Sort” button to neatly stack and re-order all items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/2644778d14c42101fb927ceb729e58f2a5cb43cf.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/2cc0c19fd2c63844ff498a13031f817acb1c3b33.gif[/img]

Need more room? This patch includes a new way to upgrade chests! Simply build your new chest directly over the old one. You’ll receive the difference in materials directly into your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40716960/58053f25c057922782ce8aabfb9d1b1452e0505c.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you, Wizards![/h3]
We want to extend our immense thanks to everyone who has played our game so far! An extra special thanks if you’ve been chatting on the community pages, talking in the Discord or submitting bug reports in the game – your participation is what makes updates like these possible! Please let us know what you think of these changes and what other features you’d like to see in future patches!


[h3]For the curious gunmancers, here is a detailed list of fixes, changes, and updates:[/h3]
[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] New communication wheel
[*] New Multiplayer UI messages
[*] Updated settings menu
[*] Updated map scroll for both controller and KBM
[*] General performance updates to networking, saving, and more
[*] Updated player animations for reload, resurrection, and more!  
[*] Several localization overflow and formatting fixes 
[*] Eyelash eyes should now appear correct on all wizards!
[*] Updated credits and special thanks
[/list]
[b]Resources, Recipes, Crafting and Building[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some buildings still making sounds after deconstruction
[*] Chests can now be directly upgraded by building over them
[*] Multiple players can now access chests, processing stations and crafting stations at the same time
[/list]
[b]Spells and Powders[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated VFX for some spells
[*] Minor fixes to some spells and powders
[/list]
[b]Enemies, NPCs and Combat [/b]
[list]
[*] Magehunter, Orion, and Barbarian SFX updated
[*] Updated VFX for some enemies 
[*] Faunaby’s quest should now be easier to trigger
[*] Hilda should no longer ignore you if you skip her dialogue or scan her too soon
[*] Updated enemy spawn rates
[*] The aimline should now rotate at a more consistent rate
[/list]

notes.title: Wizard with a Gun Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:

[h1] Wizard with a Gun 1.1.1 Changelog[/h1]

[b]Spells and Powders[/b]
[list]
[*] Loading bench bullet slot placement should now be more accurate if you’re using a controller
[*] Health and speed potions should now be applied equally when used together
[*] Speed potions should now stack correctly when used in succession
[*] Shocking effects in liquid have been updated 
[*] Cold stacks will no longer apply to an infinite amount over time
[*] Status icons should now be visible in certain edge cases
[*] Fixed crash when applying charm to two entities within the same frame
[*] Fixed crash when using resurrection bullets on a shotgun or charm AOE 
[*] Fixed grounding oil powder only working on certain loadouts
[*] Arc Count and Arc Length powders have been adjusted
[*] Toxic Breath powder has been updated

[*] Adjusted Rifle effectiveness 
[/list]

[list]

[*] Structures should no longer fall into the void if placed on the edge of water
[*] Frozen rocks health and resource drops updated
[*] Flowering cactus resource drops updated
[*] Barren Sea chest loot tables have been updated
[*] Kolbarra bark inventory stack count has been updated
[*] The “firefly” lantern should now have light
[*] Potions should no longer ignore the “transfer one” hotkey
[*] Arcana bank UI should be more accurate the the current amount of arcana stored
[*] Medium chests should now animate properly 
[*] Magus buildings should be found more often in the shatter
[*] More buildings should have proper fire SFX
[/list]
[b]Enemies, NPCs and Combat [/b]
[list]
[*] Updated VFX for thrown mites

[*] Updated sounds for Barbarians
[*] Updated sounds for Kingsgaurd
[*] General Magna will respawn in a reroll after defeat
[*] Speed boost fixed from: being frozen too long, tar powder, and assisting downed allies

[/list]
[b]General Bugs and Visual Fixes [/b]

[*] The credits were updated to accurately reflect localization and testing teams
[*] A number of small general optimization, performance, and networking issues
[*] Fixed issue with infinite spawning resources corrupting save file
[*] Fixed a number of issues with the character creation randomization feature
[*] Fixed character creator eyes to be accurate according to preview image (if you equip the ones with lashes they should now show up!)
[*] Composer gloves should now match the preview image
[*] The button mask should no longer turn your eyes into hearts when you unequip them
[*] Updated collision objects in the first tutorial island
[*] Fixed disconnect issue with players using two different languages
[/list]

notes.title: Wizard With a Gun Update 1.0.2 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, Wizardling Folk!
We are overjoyed to announce that 100,000 players have become wizards with guns. From everyone on our team, it's really a dream come true that so many people are enjoying our game. 

To celebrate, our friends at Devolver Digital have released a new video about Wizard with a Gun's development. They joined us at our home base in Seattle, Washington, for a rootin' tootin' grand ol' time. Long before this game, we worked on all sorts of projects like Rust Belt, Gurgamoth, and even a battle royal in the Cyanide and Happiness universe. We've come a long way from those days.

[previewyoutube=Pz3wk2hxPFE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]More Wizards and More Guns[/h1]

Even though we're proud of what we've built, we still have a lot more planned and a lot more work to do! There are a bunch of ways that we want to improve and add to Wizard with a Gun. If you played the single-player demo, you may have noticed that we've already implemented several changes based on your feedback. We want to continue listening and improving so this game can provide more depth and more spell-crafting adventures. 

We're starting today with a fresh update. Alongside a bunch of fixes and new features, as a special thank you, we’re adding three Halloween costume sets to the game for a limited time!

If you were part of our early Beta, you’ll notice a couple of missing features. Keep an eye on the roadmap for future updates (and keep your secrets to yourself, please)!

Check out the full list of changes in this latest update below.

[h2]Wizard With a Gun Update 1.0.2 Changelog[/h2]
[b]Spells and Powders[/b]
[list]
[*] The Oil trial should be a little less extreme
[*] Updated Spell VFX for all spells 
[/list]
[b]Resources, Recipes, Crafting and Building[/b]
[list]
[*] There are three Halloween Costume Sets!
[*] There should be updated sounds for  building and deconstruction 
[*] Wood should be the correct size when dropped 
[*] The research mechana should no longer have missing sounds
[*] Added First Edition entries for mechana, and statues that were missing 
[*] Information on bullets should now disappear when you close the loading bench 
[*] Lightning station and lightning furnace should now be the correct scale and use the correct variant models
[/list]
[b]Enemies, NPCs and Combat [/b]
[list]
[*] Young Joshua should now show all possible gun unlocks.
[*] Plenty of Enemies should have more sounds!
[*] Some enemies should now have visible fear status
[*] Hilda should be more visible in the first tutorial island (for those who just walked right by her!)
[/list]
[b]General Bugs and Visual Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] HUD ui should stay in place, no matter how rough you get damaged
[*] Corsair items should now all have consistent naming in English 
[*] Falling into the void should only play the drop animation once on the wizard 
[*] The chests in the Shatter should now have the correct size
[*] There should no longer be a significant delay during certain transitions on the Chronomancer’s wheel 
[*] There should now be collision on soul tethers 
[*] There is a randomize button in the character creator 
[*] Sound has been fixed for “Hot” and “Cold” states in certain biomes 
[*] Gear drops should now reflect the UI in the Chronomancer’s wheel 
[*] Statue of flora should now have a map icon 
[*] Statues of flora should no longer be deconstructible (you monsters!) 
[*] The chest will no longer silence the music when you open it
[/list]
